v3s.unit: per question, at k = 3, on the LEG questions (as v3)

v3s.charge: a question with at least one INFEASIBLE verified pick costs kappa regret units, whatever any later pick returned; every other question costs its v3 bounded regret
v3s.unresolved_missing_failed_infra: not charged kappa: such a question keeps v3's own handling (its bounded regret, or unscored)

sign.pairs: the B5-B8 reference pairs of Data Collection's calibration panel (shared/evidence/physics-calibration-01), named by the sha256 of its MANIFEST.json, NOT scoring cases. Until a manifest digest is pinned in a committed addendum, sign is not computed and every rule using it is withheld.
sign.pair_rule: every pair of panel cases differing in exactly the law's input, all other inputs equal (not only adjacent pairs)
sign.laws: B5 peak T vs c1 and vs c2; B6 plating margin vs c1; B7 plating margin vs T_amb; B8 peak T vs T_amb; outputs by the decision contract's measure
sign.evaluable: reference |change| >= epsilon x that law's reference range over its pairs; a zero or smaller reference change is not evaluable
sign.missing_prediction: a member missing a prediction on any evaluable pair is unmeasured (withheld)
sign.measure: disagreeing evaluable pairs / evaluable pairs; FAIL when it exceeds the cutoff

anything_else: HUMAN_INPUT, fail-closed: the rule is withheld, never scored
